subject: Error Host Per-User Application Directories using :HOME_USER: and user_dirs;

messages.author: 175381693d32b1e7
messages.subject: Error Host Per-User Application Directories using :HOME_USER: and user_dirs;
parts:
My shiny-server is running under user root, at configuration file I'm using :HOME_USER: and user_dirs;
Application is running fine - but I've errors at server level
[ERROR] shiny-server - Error attempting to change permissions on log file at ~/ShinyApps/log/hello-<username>20140701-103532-45319.log: EPERM, fchown
At ~/ShinyApps/log files are created under nobody:nogroup
Log files are not accessible by users without root privilege so they are not able to debug the application.

Thanks,
Sonia

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: Error Host Per-User Application Directories using :HOME_USER: and user_dirs;
parts:
Hi Sonia,

Can you please provide some more information about your setup and environment (if you prefer you can send then in a private email to me):

- What Linux distribution you are using
- What version of Shiny Server (shiny-server --version)
- Your shiny-server.conf file
- Information about the user you are running the application as:
  + grep <username> /etc/passwd
  + grep <username> /etc/group
  + ls -al /home
  + ls -al /home/<username>
  + ps aux | grep shiny  (when you are running the application)


Thanks,
Fereshteh

messages.subject: Re: Error Host Per-User Application Directories using :HOME_USER: and user_dirs;
parts:
Hi Fereshteh
Thanks for the time.

We are working in a very complex environment (Debian,common file system), I'm not sure I have all the answers,
 
Shiny version
Shiny Server v1.1.0.0
Node.js v0.10.21

When the application is running I can see that the spawn R process are under the correct user and not root.
sonia    10008  9.9  0.6 194772 54728 ?        S    12:16   0:01 /usr/local/lib/R-3.0.2/lib/R/bin/exec/R --no-save --slave -f /usr/local/stow/shiny/lib/shiny-server/R/SockJSAdapter.R
root     23708  0.0  0.5 975788 46440 ?        Sl   Jul02   0:01 /usr/local/stow/shiny/lib/shiny-server/ext/node/bin/shiny-server /usr/local/stow/shiny/lib/shiny-server/lib/main.js /usr/local/lib/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf
My config file is very simple
runa_as :HOME_USER:
location {
                user_dirs;
}


What I basically need is the option to have log files in a common path even using user_dirs :HOME_USER:, this will give me the flexibility I need.
Do you know if It can be done?

Thanks,
Sonia

parts:
Hi Sonia,

That is not currently possible. I opened a ticket (https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-server/issues/78) to add this feature. I think it is a useful option to have.

Let us know if we can help with anything else,
Fereshteh
